posts.title: How I keep T&M change orders from turning into argument invoices
posts.text: How I keep T&M change orders from turning into argument invoices Every GC I know has lost money on a "quick" T&M change that somehow became a fight three weeks later. Not because the work was wrong - because nobody could show what was approved, when, and at what rate. Here is the simple log I keep on every job that has any T&M. Works in any spreadsheet. One row per day of T&M work, not one row per invoice. 1. Get the rate sheet signed before the first hour. Labor rates by trade, burdened... How I keep T&M change orders from turning into argument invoices
posts.author: cmgnspire

posts.title: What do you do when an estimate goes unanswered?
posts.text: Genuine question — I've been talking to a lot of shops lately. You send the quote, hear nothing back. Do you follow up? How many times, and how — call, text, email? Or just move on to the next job? Trying to understand what actually works vs. what everyone means to do but doesn't. What's your process?
posts.author: TradeStack
